notices.name: Plain facts
notices.text:
Subject: Your Meridian card account is moving to Harbor Bank

Harbor Bank acquired Meridian, and your Meridian credit card account will move to Harbor Bank on March 9.

What stays the same: your card number, your rewards balance, your credit limit, and your scheduled payments.

What changes: after March 9 you will manage your card on the Harbor Bank website and app. You will need to create a Harbor Bank login the first time you sign in. Your Meridian login will stop working on that date.

To get ready, open the Meridian app now and follow the prompt to set up your Harbor Bank login. It takes about five minutes.

notices.name: Benefits first
notices.text:
Subject: Good news: more ways to earn with your Meridian card

Starting March 9, your Meridian card comes with new Harbor Bank perks: up to 10% cash back at hundreds of online stores through Harbor Offers, and 5% back on hotels and rental cars booked through Harbor Travel. Your current rewards rate and balance stay exactly as they are.

To start using these perks, set up your Harbor Bank login. Open the Meridian app and follow the prompt. It takes about five minutes.

After March 9 you will manage your card on the Harbor Bank website and app, and your Meridian login will stop working. Your card number, credit limit, and scheduled payments do not change.

notices.name: Security first
notices.text:
Subject: Your Meridian card is moving to Harbor Bank. Here is how to know this message is real.

Your Meridian credit card account moves to Harbor Bank on March 9. Your card number, rewards balance, credit limit, and scheduled payments stay the same.

How to set up your new login safely: do not click links in emails or texts about this move, including this one. Open the Meridian app you already have, and it will walk you through creating your Harbor Bank login. It takes about five minutes. Harbor Bank will never call or text you to ask for your password, PIN, or a one-time code.

After March 9 you will manage your card on the Harbor Bank website and app, and your Meridian login will stop working.
